items.title: George Mitchell Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: I, I, I made, uh, seems to me like it was, was with Lil when I made that with Johnny, when Johnny was on there.

ctx.x: You don't remember that? No. I thought maybe you did. No, I don't think I'd done any, made any recording with Heinz. Do you remember making some records with, uh, Johnny Dodds any time? Dodds made so many records that always have him made.
I, I, I made, uh, seems to me like it was, was with Lil when I made that with Johnny, when Johnny was on there.
Yes, he was on that date too, those early ones with Ori and all, but I wondered any later ones, like, seems like Nanny Dominick told me he played with you. Now, where did he play with you?
